rule: A Lean proof establishes a mathematical consequence of a definition. It is never evidence that APGI describes the brain. 'empirically-supported' requires a cited dataset and a pre-registered prediction ID.

claims.text: Raising θ cannot make ignition easier at fixed S.
The clamped update preserves the positivity floor θ_floor (0 AU by default).

The θ₀ band [0.25, 0.85] AU is not an invariant of the clamped update for unrestricted targets; it is invariant when targets lie in the band and 0 ≤ g ≤ 1. Consistent with the Notation Appendix: θₜ may leave the band transiently.
a < 0 is necessary for cusp bistability (and hence hysteresis).
Three distinct cusp equilibria exist if and only if 4a³ + 27θ² < 0 (which forces a < 0).
claims.note: Sufficiency proved first (cusp_three_equilibria); the converse (task 28) makes it an equivalence. Twins: test_cusp_three_equilibria, test_cusp_three_equilibria_converse, test_cusp_discriminant.

claims.text: Forward-Euler relaxation stays in bounds when Δt ≤ τ.
APGI's hysteresis prediction (Innovation 4) holds in human data.
κ (ATP per bit of ignition-event information) has no canonical value; published sensitivity calculations span 3 × 10³ to 10⁹ ATP/bit.
claims.note: Replaces the draft claim 'κ ≈ 1,700, dimensionless overhead'. Uncalibrated by the corpus's own statement (Notation Appendix p22).

claims.text: The exact exponential decay (Math Spec Eq. 32) keeps θ inside any interval that contains θ and θ₀, for every step dt ≥ 0, with no step-size condition.
The hazard sampler is dt-invariant: n steps of dt have the same survival probability as one step of n·dt, and the per-step probability lies in [0, 1] and rises with the propensity Bₜ.
claims.note: Backs PD-HAZARD. Per-step Bernoulli(Bₜ) sampling is not dt-invariant (test_per_step_bernoulli_is_not_dt_invariant).

claims.text: Raising θ cannot raise the per-step ignition probability under the hazard with logistic propensity.
The exact leaky-integrator gain λ = 1 − exp(−dt/τ_S) lies in (0, 1) for dt > 0; the integrator stays inside any interval containing S and S_inst and is dt-invariant under constant input.
The NE clamp enforces |γ_NE|·g_NE ≤ 0.5 for either sign of γ_NE, keeps 1 + γ_NE·g_NE in [0.5, 1.5], and so never drives a positive threshold to zero.
The canonical threshold step (Eq. 26, exact decay, floor) respects θ_floor; with δ_reset ≥ 0 an ignition never lowers the next threshold, and with η_θ ≥ 0 a larger C − V never lowers it.
Ψ(z) is strictly bounded by max(α⁺, α⁻); with α⁺ = α⁻ and γ⁺ = γ⁻ it reduces to α·tanh(γ·z), which is odd.
With β_SM ≥ 0, Πⁱ_eff is non-negative and non-decreasing in M̂(c,a); the hard clamp keeps it in [Π_min, Π_max].
